thread:
Alex R.: Heads up — seeing users end up with two roles after SSO JIT. Looks like email aliasing (alice@ vs alice+gh@) created duplicates. Not sure which attribute we used as the JIT key. @Maria C. any idea?
Maria C.: Ugh. That sounds like the JIT lookup used `email` but the assertion also contains `mail`/`altEmail`. Can you dump a sample SAML assertion and the user create log?
Alex R.: Pasting a sanitized assertion and the log snippet:
```
<NameID>urn:uuid:1234-abcd</NameID>
<Attribute Name="email">alice+github@company.com</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="mail">alice@company.com</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="uid">alice</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="groups">engineering;infra</Attribute>
```
Log:
```
[2026-03-15T12:34:56Z] user.created id=usr_8f3 external_id=urn:uuid:1234-abcd email=alice+github@company.com source=sso
[2026-03-15T12:34:57Z] user.created id=usr_b12 external_id=urn:uuid:5678-efgh email=alice@company.com source=sso
```
Jordan L.: That pattern screams attribute-priority change. We used to prefer `persistentNameID`/`NameID` (stable) then `mail`. If a recent deploy flipped priority to `email` it would create two principals when aliases differ. Check recent mapping PRs.
Tia N.: I think the mapping tweak from last week changed to prefer `mail` -> `email` (legacy compatibility) in the attr-mapping service. @Sam can you confirm deploys around 2034567800?
Sam (deploy-bot): deploy-service: mapping-service v2.7.4 deployed to prod at 2034567800 by @ci-bot — changelog: "prefer email attr when present"
Maria C.: That explains it. We need three immediate actions: rollback the mapping change or patch JIT to canonicalize emails; add raw-assertion capture to audit logs when creating users; and a dedupe migration for affected accounts.
Alex R.: I can run a dedupe in staging. Plan: normalize via lowercasing + strip `+` tags and dots for gmail-like domains, then merge users with same normalized_email but different external_id. Will backup DB first.
Jordan L.: Careful: merging can accidentally merge service accounts or SCIM-provisioned users. Add guard: only merge if `source==sso` and `last_login` from SSO and `is_service_account==false`.
Maria C.: Agreed. I'll open an incident ticket and assign the rollout owner. Quick mitigations: roll back PR 3421 (attr-mapping change) and hotfix JIT to prefer `NameID` if present. Also add an audit event `sso.assertion.received` with the raw attributes for any user.create path.
Tia N.: For the audit/KMS question — if we store raw assertions in S3 encrypted with customer-managed KMS key? Not necessary now; we can store minimal attributes encrypted with platform KMS and link to full assertion in secure archival store. But ensure access is audited.
Alex R.: I'll prepare the migration script, will test in staging and share commands. Draft snippet for dedupe check:
```
# find candidates
SELECT id,email,external_id FROM users WHERE source='sso' AND normalized_email IN (
  SELECT normalized_email FROM users GROUP BY normalized_email HAVING COUNT(*)>1
);
# merge: merge_user(src_id, target_id)
```
Jordan L.: Add an extra check for `created_at` window and active org membership to avoid merging old test accounts.
Maria C.: Action items: (1) rollback mapping PR 3421 — @oncall infra to assist (2) hotfix JIT to prefer NameID & add canonicalization — assigned to me (3) write dedupe migration and run in staging — assigned to Alex (4) add audit event & retention policy — assigned to security team (me). ETA: rollback within 1h, hotfix + audit in 6h, migration EOD.
Alex R.: I'll take DB snapshot and run staging test. Posting plan in #incidents once snapshot done. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: incident created INC-2026-045 — priority P2 — paging infra oncall
Maria C.: I'll follow up with a short RFC for the long-term policy: JIT matching keys should be deterministic (prefer persistent NameID, then canonical email), and we must log raw SAML attributes for post-mortem. Saving that as a policy doc.
Tia N.: Thanks — please @me on the RFC, will review the KMS/audit bits.
Alex R.: Thanks everyone, will update here after staging run. :eyes:
